md_notes: **Authority:** this file is the live RW plan. Older versioned RW plans cited by tickets are kept verbatim in `rw_plan_binding_record/` as historical binding authority; MEP-AF2 Appendix V6 supersedes their train rules.

**Landed:** a ticket is `landed` only when its ticket record or merge commit records its write set as merged into `development` complete; code commits alone do not set it. At the read pin this holds for T-IGX-051-D (PR #670) and T-IGX-051-E (PR #674, part D ec89a1df8). T-IGX-056-A (EQO ticket, approved by the Operator on 2026-11-23) and T-IGX-065-A (PT-T01 Campaign B, NT-01..NT-16, owner AF-CLOSE under D-2) are not train tickets.

**Ordering choice:** the edge T-IGX-078-C before T-IGX-051-A follows WORKLIST section 5 (TENANT merges last, shared nexus_loop.py). It makes T-IGX-051-G a transitive predecessor of T-IGX-051-A and makes TENANT wait on an unplanned ticket whose typed-seam part depends on an Operator item (Q-WF-04). PLAN_T-IGX-051-A allows, but does not require, parallel work with RW-TYP; the orchestrator may revisit this order.

**Planned tests:** a negative test marked `planned; not authored at the read pin` takes its file name from the row table of the versioned plan v21 or from the owner plan; owners follow the current matrix inventory. An id ending in `-P` is an existing probe that covers a narrower case than the defined test of that row.
**Red-first column:** statuses come from the previous plan JSON, then the red-first record, then the listed record corrections. Earlier hand-written notes in this file are no longer kept here.
